english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for stating something clearly or spelling out a condition.
Use this when the emphasis is on stating something clearly or making it explicit.
Use this in casual speech when stressing that the condition has been clearly stated to the other party.

examples.english: You need to specify the deadline first.
examples.traditional: 你要先講明個截止日期喎。
examples.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 sin1 gong2 ming4 go3 zit6 zi2 jat6 kei4 wo3

examples.english: If you have any demands, express them clearly; there's no need to beat around the bush.
examples.traditional: 你有咩要求就講明啦，唔使兜圈子。
examples.jyutping: nei5 jau5 me1 jiu1 kau4 zau6 gong2 ming4 laa1 m4 sai2 dau1 hyun1 zi2

examples.english: We stipulate from the start that anyone arriving late has to pay for themselves.
examples.traditional: 我哋一開始就講明，遲到要自己畀錢。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 hoi1 ci2 zau6 gong2 ming4 ci4 dou3 jiu3 zi6 gei2 bei2 cin4
